title: The Cerebellar Exam — Finger-Nose, Rapid Movements, Heel-Shin and DANISH

hook.en: Clumsy, wobbly, overshooting — the cerebellum is the brain's quality controller for movement. Learn the three limb tests, the DANISH signs and how to tell cerebellar ataxia from sensory ataxia.
hook.ur: Anari, ladkhadati, target se aage nikalti harkat — cerebellum movement ka quality controller hai. Teen limb tests, DANISH signs aur cerebellar ataxia ko sensory ataxia se alag karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll perform finger-to-nose, rapid alternating movements and heel-to-shin, name the DANISH signs and separate cerebellar from sensory ataxia.
goal.ur: End tak aap finger-to-nose, rapid alternating movements aur heel-to-shin karenge, DANISH signs batayenge aur cerebellar ko sensory ataxia se alag karenge.

text.en: The **cerebellum** does not start movement; it **smooths and corrects** it by comparing the plan with what actually happened. Damage causes movements that are the wrong size, speed or timing, and the signs are on the **same side** as a hemispheric lesion. The classic signs spell **DANISH**: **D**ysdiadochokinesia, **A**taxia, **N**ystagmus, **I**ntention tremor, **S**lurred speech, **H**ypotonia.
text.ur: **Cerebellum** movement shuru nahi karta; yeh plan ko jo asal mein hua us se compare kar ke usay **smooth aur durust** karta hai. Nuksan se movements ka size, speed ya timing ghalat hota hai, aur signs hemispheric lesion ki **usi side** par hote hain. Classic signs **DANISH** banate hain: **D**ysdiadochokinesia, **A**taxia, **N**ystagmus, **I**ntention tremor, **S**lurred speech, **H**ypotonia.

text.en: The cerebellum is the satnav of the body. The driver (motor cortex) picks the destination, the satnav keeps correcting the route. Without it you still reach the destination, but you swerve, overshoot the turn and brake too late: that is ataxia and overshoot.
text.ur: Cerebellum jism ka satnav hai. Driver (motor cortex) manzil chunta hai, satnav raasta durust karta rehta hai. Iske bagair bhi aap pohnch jate hain, lekin idhar udhar jhoolte hain, mor se aage nikal jate hain aur der se brake lagate hain: yehi ataxia aur overshoot hai.

intro.en: The patient touches **their nose, then the examiner's finger**, which moves to a new place each time. Switch the **Patient** option between "Healthy" and "Cerebellar lesion" and watch for the shaking that grows near the target (**intention tremor**) and the overshoot (**past-pointing**).
intro.ur: Patient **apni nose, phir examiner ki finger** ko touch karta hai jo har baar nayi jagah jati hai. **Patient** option ko “Healthy” aur “Cerebellar lesion” ke beech badlein aur target ke qareeb barhta hua kaanpna (**intention tremor**) aur overshoot (**past-pointing**) dekhein.

question.en: A patient's finger shakes more and more as it approaches the examiner's finger and then overshoots. What is this?
question.ur: Patient ki finger examiner ki finger ke qareeb pohnchte hue zyada kaampti hai aur phir overshoot karti hai. Yeh kya hai?

text.en: Intention tremor and dysmetria (a cerebellar sign)

feedback.en: Yes — the tremor appears with purposeful movement and worsens near the target. A resting tremor is different (Parkinson's disease).
feedback.ur: Haan — tremor purposeful movement mein aata hai aur target ke qareeb barhta hai. Resting tremor alag hai (Parkinson’s disease).

feedback.en: A resting tremor is present when the limb is still and lessens with movement.
feedback.ur: Resting tremor tab hota hai jab limb saakin ho aur harkat se kam hota hai.

feedback.en: Normal movement is smooth and lands on the target.
feedback.ur: Normal movement smooth hoti hai aur target par pohnchti hai.

intro.en: The patient pats one palm on the other hand or thigh, then flips it over, as fast and regularly as possible. In "Cerebellar lesion" the rhythm becomes slow, uneven and clumsy: **dysdiadochokinesia**.
intro.ur: Patient ek palm ko doosray haath ya thigh par thapthapata hai, phir palat deta hai, jitni tezi aur regularity se ho sake. “Cerebellar lesion” mein rhythm aahista, be-tarteeb aur anari ho jata hai: **dysdiadochokinesia**.

intro.en: Lying supine, the patient places the heel on the opposite knee and slides it smoothly down the shin to the ankle and back. A healthy heel follows the shin; the cerebellar heel wanders off and overshoots.
intro.ur: Supine lete hue patient heel ko opposite knee par rakhta hai aur shin ke saath smoothly ankle tak aur wapas slide karta hai. Healthy heel shin ko follow karti hai; cerebellar heel bhatak jati hai aur overshoot karti hai.

rows.en: Little change — already unsteady with eyes open
rows.ur: Bohat kam tabdeeli — aankhein khuli hone par bhi unsteady
Bohat zyada kharab — vision compensate kar rahi thi
Pair patakhte hue, pairon ko dekhte hue

rows.en: Nystagmus, slurred speech, intention tremor, hypotonia
rows.ur: Nystagmus, slurred speech, intention tremor, hypotonia

rows.en: Reduced vibration and joint position sense, absent ankle jerks
rows.ur: Vibration aur joint position sense kam, ankle jerks gayab

rows.en: Stroke, MS, alcohol, tumour, hereditary ataxia
rows.ur: Stroke, MS, sharab, tumour, hereditary ataxia

rows.en: Neuropathy, B12 deficiency, dorsal column disease
rows.ur: Neuropathy, B12 ki kami, dorsal column disease

text.en: **Calling weakness or pain "ataxia".** A weak arm falls short of the nose because it is weak; a painful shoulder moves slowly because it hurts. Always check power, sensation and range first. The test also needs the patient to understand and to be able to see. Do not forget **to compare sides and to move the target finger** — a fixed target lets patients learn the path.
text.ur: **Kamzori ya dard ko “ataxia” kehna.** Kamzor arm nose tak isliye nahi pohnchta ke woh kamzor hai; dard wala shoulder isliye aahista chalta hai ke dard hota hai. Pehle power, sensation aur range check karein. Test ke liye patient ka samajhna aur dekh sakna bhi zaroori hai. **Sides compare karna aur target finger ko hilana** na bhoolein — fixed target patient ko raasta yaad karwa deta hai.

text.en: **Treating ataxia.** Cerebellar ataxia responds to task-specific practice, weighted wrist or ankle cuffs, visual cues, proximal stability work and balance training; slow the movement down and break it into parts. Sensory ataxia is helped by vision, proprioceptive training, a wider base, a walking aid and a safe, well-lit environment. Always screen for a treatable cause (B12, alcohol, medicines like phenytoin) and refer sudden onset for urgent imaging.
text.ur: **Ataxia ka ilaaj.** Cerebellar ataxia task-specific practice, weighted wrist ya ankle cuffs, visual cues, proximal stability work aur balance training se behtar hoti hai; movement ko aahista karein aur hisson mein tor dein. Sensory ataxia vision, proprioceptive training, chauray base, walking aid aur mehfooz, roshan mahol se behtar hoti hai. Treatable wajah (B12, sharab, phenytoin jaisi dawaiyan) hamesha screen karein aur achanak shuru hone par urgent imaging ke liye refer karein.

question.en: A patient is unsteady with eyes open and equally unsteady with eyes closed, with nystagmus and slurred speech. Which type of ataxia?
question.ur: Patient aankhein khuli aur band dono mein barabar unsteady hai, nystagmus aur slurred speech ke saath. Kaun si ataxia?

feedback.en: Yes — no extra loss with eyes closed, plus nystagmus and dysarthria, means the cerebellum.
feedback.ur: Haan — aankhein band karne par zyada kami nahi, saath nystagmus aur dysarthria cerebellum batate hain.

feedback.en: Sensory ataxia worsens clearly when the eyes close.
feedback.ur: Sensory ataxia aankhein band karne par wazeh barhti hai.

feedback.en: Nystagmus and slurred speech are organic cerebellar signs.
feedback.ur: Nystagmus aur slurred speech organic cerebellar signs hain.

question.en: The patient's left arm shows ataxia. Which side of the cerebellum is probably damaged, and why?
question.ur: Patient ke left arm mein ataxia hai. Cerebellum ki kaun si side shayad kharab hai aur kyun?

answer.en: The **left** side. The cerebellum controls the **same side** of the body: its pathways cross twice (once on the way up, once on the way down), so the effect returns to the same side. Midline (vermis) damage affects the trunk and gait instead.
answer.ur: **Left** side. Cerebellum jism ki **usi side** ko control karta hai: iske pathways do baar cross karte hain (ek baar upar jate hue, ek baar neeche aate hue), is liye asar usi side par lautta hai. Midline (vermis) ka nuksan trunk aur gait ko affect karta hai.

text.en: Bedside cerebellar signs have **good specificity but only moderate sensitivity**: a positive test is useful, a normal test does not exclude mild disease. Gait and tandem walking are the most sensitive bedside tests for mild cerebellar disease, and the Scale for the Assessment and Rating of Ataxia (SARA) gives a reliable score (0–40; higher is worse) to monitor change over time.
text.ur: Bedside cerebellar signs ki **specificity achi lekin sensitivity sirf moderate** hai: positive test kaam ka hai, normal test halki bimari ko rule out nahi karta. Gait aur tandem walking halki cerebellar bimari ke liye sab se sensitive bedside tests hain, aur Scale for the Assessment and Rating of Ataxia (SARA) waqt ke saath tabdeeli monitor karne ke liye bharosay ka score (0–40; zyada matlab kharab) deta hai.

question.en: Which test is the most sensitive bedside test for mild cerebellar disease?
question.ur: Halki cerebellar bimari ke liye sab se sensitive bedside test kaun sa hai?

feedback.en: Yes — a failure to walk a straight line is often the first sign.
feedback.ur: Haan — seedhi line par na chal pana aksar pehli nishani hoti hai.

feedback.en: Limb tests can be normal in mild disease; gait is more revealing.
feedback.ur: Halki bimari mein limb tests normal ho sakte hain; gait zyada batati hai.

feedback.en: The knee jerk may be pendular, but it is not a sensitive test.
feedback.ur: Knee jerk pendular ho sakta hai, lekin yeh sensitive test nahi.

text.en: **Refer urgently** if ataxia has a sudden onset, comes with a severe headache, vomiting, double vision, neck pain or drowsiness (posterior circulation stroke, cerebellar haemorrhage, a tumour or an infection), or if a child or adult worsens over days. Do not mistake a posterior-circulation stroke for "just dizziness".
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar ataxia achanak shuru ho, shadeed sir dard, ulti, double vision, gardan dard ya neend ke saath ho (posterior circulation stroke, cerebellar haemorrhage, tumour ya infection), ya bachay ya bade mein chand dinon mein kharabi barhe. Posterior-circulation stroke ko “sirf chakkar” na samjhein.

summary.en: The cerebellum smooths movement: damage gives same-side ataxia, intention tremor, dysdiadochokinesia, nystagmus, slurred speech and hypotonia (DANISH).
summary.ur: Cerebellum movement ko smooth karta hai: nuksan se usi side ki ataxia, intention tremor, dysdiadochokinesia, nystagmus, slurred speech aur hypotonia (DANISH) hotay hain.

summary.en: Test finger-nose, rapid alternating movements and heel-shin, move the target, compare sides and rule out weakness and pain first.
summary.ur: Finger-nose, rapid alternating movements aur heel-shin test karein, target hilayein, sides compare karein aur pehle kamzori aur dard ko rule out karein.

summary.en: Eyes-closed worsening means sensory ataxia; no change with nystagmus means cerebellar; sudden onset or headache needs urgent referral.
summary.ur: Aankhein band karne par kharabi sensory ataxia; nystagmus ke saath koi tabdeeli nahi cerebellar; achanak shuruaat ya sir dard urgent refer.

back.en: Dysdiadochokinesia, Ataxia, Nystagmus, Intention tremor, Slurred speech, Hypotonia.
back.ur: Dysdiadochokinesia, Ataxia, Nystagmus, Intention tremor, Slurred speech, Hypotonia.

front.en: Which side of the body does one cerebellar hemisphere control?
front.ur: Ek cerebellar hemisphere jism ki kaun si side control karta hai?

front.en: How do cerebellar and sensory ataxia differ with eyes closed?
front.ur: Aankhein band karne par cerebellar aur sensory ataxia mein kya farq hai?

back.en: Sensory ataxia gets much worse with eyes closed; cerebellar ataxia does not change much.
back.ur: Sensory ataxia aankhein band karne par bohat kharab hoti hai; cerebellar ataxia mein zyada tabdeeli nahi.

back.en: Inability to perform rapid alternating movements smoothly (slow, uneven and clumsy).
back.ur: Rapid alternating movements ko smoothly na kar pana (aahista, be-tarteeb aur anari).
